title: Wide dialogs outside ModalForm run edge to edge between `sm` and their max width (no viewport gutter): the action modal `lg` / `xl` (measured) and six more wide `DialogContent` sites
body:
Filing gate ①: a measured, user-reachable layout defect. This is the same family as objectui#12593, at locations that card's PR deliberately keeps out. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01JZnppgHRp4sREcouhkQYDB`) from the out-of-scope finding of PR #12598's dev report. ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

reach (measured):
- A named producer is objectstack `examples/app-showcase`'s `showcase_quick_view`: an action of type `modal` with a page target and no size.
- The console's action modal (`packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx`, `resolveModalTarget`) opens such a page target at size `xl`.

reach (by source, not yet measured):
- the other sites listed below, wherever a window is narrower than their max width.

## Mechanism

The Shadcn `DialogContent` primitive draws `w-full max-w-lg`, `fixed`, centred by `left-[50%]` / `translate-x-[-50%]`. A consumer class `sm:max-w-Nxl` raises the cap from `sm` up. Below that cap, nothing keeps a margin, so the dialog is as wide as the window, at x = 0.

objectui#12593 fixes this for `ModalForm` only, with one shared token `sm:w-[calc(100%-2rem)]` read by its `lg` and `xl` sizes (PR #12598).

## Measured (PR #12598's Chromium harness over the console's emitted CSS, the action modal's `xl` class list)

| Viewport | Width · left/right gutter (px) |
|:--|:--|
| 1440 | 1024 · 208/208 |
| 1024 | 1024 · 0/0 (edge to edge) |
| 768 | 768 · 0/0 (edge to edge) |

## Enumeration (every wide centred `DialogContent` on `main` `8415d9f111`; sheets are edge-anchored by design and excluded)

| Site | Wide class | Edge to edge between |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `app-shell/src/hooks/useActionModal.tsx` `SIZE_CLASS` | `lg` `sm:max-w-2xl`, `xl` `sm:max-w-5xl` | 640–672 / 640–1024 px (measured for `xl`) |
| `app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx` (a long parameter list) | `sm:max-w-3xl` | 640–768 px |
| `app-shell/src/views/FlowRunner.tsx` (an object form or long screen) | `sm:max-w-3xl` | 640–768 px |
| `app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/CelTestRunDialog.tsx` | `sm:max-w-2xl` | 640–672 px |
| `components/src/custom/fullscreen-editor.tsx` | `sm:max-w-3xl` | 640–768 px |
| `fields/src/widgets/RecordPickerDialog.tsx` (width by column count, ceiling `sm:max-w-3xl lg:max-w-5xl`) | up to `5xl` | 640–768 and 1024–1024+ px |
| `plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx` | `sm:max-w-4xl` | 640–896 px |

`fields/src/widgets/ImageLightbox.tsx` carries `max-w-[92vw] sm:max-w-4xl`. The `sm:` cap replaces the 92vw at `sm` and up, so it is likely in the family too. It needs measuring.

## Ask (for triage to scope)

- **Fix shape, one rule:** every wide centred dialog keeps the 1rem gutter from `sm` up, by one shared rule, ⛔ not a literal per site. Today `ModalForm` owns its own token, after PR #12598. The fix could promote that token to one export the sites read, or put the gutter in `DialogContent`'s own base for `sm` and up. The second edits a Shadcn-synced primitive, so its owner decides.
- **Enumeration pin:** a census that lists every `DialogContent` with a `sm:max-w-` above `lg` and asserts each reads the shared gutter. A new wide dialog then cannot reintroduce the edge.
- **CONTROLs:** sheets, the phone sheet below `sm`, and `full` (95vw).

Dedupe (searched this act: "dialog runs edge to edge no viewport margin wide max-width action modal", "useActionModal size class xl dialog width"): only objectui#12593, this family's `ModalForm` member, and closed layout cards (objectui#618, #620, #1009, #12080) that are not this defect.
